lesson: Grip the source shaft while leaving the bow accessible to the receiving hand. Close and settle the receiver before opening the giver, then verify current retained-key pixels before insertion.

Reconstruct or refresh the current key-to-gripper relation after handoff. A commanded closed hand is not proof of possession. Keep fine insertion and turn movements referenced to the key tip and observed hole.
Reserve the native300-action budget for pickup, handoff, alignment, insertion and turn. A lifted key gives only partial progress and is not native success.
Separate grasp miss, slip and occlusion: require visible key motion relative to the table and consistency relative to the gripper before declaring retention.
